name: Κέδρος
evidence: Pinned to the Raches/Achinos coast of Stylida (Maliakos gulf) via lat/lng. Multiple query variants (Κέδρος + Ράχες / Αχινός / Στυλίδα) return only the famous Kedros of Donousa or the generally organized Raches main beach; no source names a Kedros beach in Fthiotida at all. Genuinely unresolvable.

name: Παραλία Αγίου Γεωργίου Πελασγίας
evidence: Disambiguated to Agios Georgios of Pelasgia, Stylida/Fthiotida (matches lat/lng and the small church + parking-by-the-church detail). Local sources (stilida.com / foursquare listing) state it 'is not an organized beach — bring water, food and umbrellas'. An earlier vaguer mention of municipally-installed umbrellas could not be tied to this beach; the specific local description wins.

name: Σχοινιά
evidence: Disambiguated from Schinias Attica by anchoring on Livanates (lat/lng matches the Livanates coast, Dimos Lokron). Multiple specific sources: municipality-placed umbrellas and showers on Schinias Livanates beach (fonografos.net), plus named on-beach operators Blanco Beach Bar and Barracuda Beach Bar offering free sunbeds and umbrellas (pointfinder.eu listings with phone numbers).

name: Λαιμός
evidence: Pinned to Laimos on the Corinthian gulf coast of Viotia past the Alyki archaeological site (matches lat/lng). Sources only say it is reached 'by a mountainous, difficult dirt road requiring 4x4' — strongly suggesting no facilities, but no source explicitly states unorganized/no sunbeds. WonderGreece detail page unreachable (expired certificate).

name: Agios Nikolaos
evidence: Agios Nikolaos Sithonia is an inland village; its coastal area (lat/lng points to the shore NW of Ormos Panagias) is covered by directories (sithoniagreece.com) that list only Akti Salonikiou, Schinia and Elaion nearby — none named 'Agios Nikolaos' and no facility info. Organized beaches in the area (Trani Ammouda etc.) are distinct beaches; cannot pin any sunbed/bar claim to this record.

name: Λύκος
evidence: Unambiguous locality: Lykos/Likkos bay, Sfakia south coast between Loutro and Marmara (matches lat/lng). Taverna Akrogiali sits directly on Lykos beach and its listings state it 'offers sunbeds'; Georgoshouse (also on the bay) advertises free sunbeds and hammocks adjoining the beach. Sunbeds are taverna/guesthouse-provided rather than a concession, and cretanbeaches confirms only tavernas with rooms — no beach bar.

name: Παραλία Θανάσης
evidence: Pinned via lat/lng to the western beach of Stavros, Akrotiri Chania — documented as 'beach near Taverna Thanasis, Stavros, Akrotiri peninsula' (Alamy caption confirms the name/place pairing). Multiple guides (cretanbeaches, elizabethestateagency) state Stavros has two sandy beaches 'organized with canteens, umbrellas and sun beds'. Sunbeds inferred for this specific (Thanasis/western) beach from that two-beach statement, hence not high confidence.

name: Παραλία Χαλέπα
evidence: Lat/lng lands on the Chalepa quarter shore of Chania town. The swimming spot of Chalepa (Kouloura) is explicitly described: 'not a typical beach with umbrellas, beach bars and crowds… you won't find sunbeds or music there' (cretaone/despinastudios). No source describes any organized section on the Chalepa shoreline.

name: Άμμος Ξερόκαμπου
evidence: Xerokambos (Zakros, Sitia) confirmed via lat/lng. Cretanbeaches' Xerokambos page lists umbrellas/showers only as general-area amenities and gives no per-beach details for the Ammos sub-beach; guides stress the area is remote with tavernas only in the settlement. Cannot tie sunbeds to this specific sub-beach.

name: Βόλια
evidence: Round-1 tied this to Xerokambos, but the lat/lng (35.320, 25.567) is on the north coast just west of Milatos — the Volaki area, where cretanbeaches says a hotel (Minos Imperial) 'created two artificial beaches with sand on either side of a concrete pier'. Hotel beach almost certainly has hotel sunbeds, but no source explicitly states sunbeds/public organization, so staying UNCLEAR per the rules.

name: Βουρλιά
evidence: Lat/lng matches Vourlia, the central-settlement beach of Xerokambos. Cretanbeaches (a reputable Crete guide, upgrading round-1's 'low-quality map listing') describes the Vourlia settlement beach as 'αρκετά οργανωμένη' (fairly organized) and lists umbrellas among the beach's amenities; tavernas are in the settlement. No explicit sunbed count, hence sunbeds left null and confidence medium.

name: Χιόνα Παλαίκαστρου
evidence: Unambiguous locality (Chiona, 2 km from Palaikastro, Sitia — matches lat/lng). Resolving the round-1 conflict: cretazine and crete-today both state the beach has 'λίγες ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες' (a few sunbeds and umbrellas) plus tamarisks, and famous fish tavernas directly on the beach (e.g. Chiona tavern). So lightly but genuinely organized: few sunbeds yes, no beach bar.

name: Palm Bay Beach
evidence: Lat/lng = Sissi, Lasithi, in front of the Palm Bay Hotel (by Estia). Hotel pages confirm 'direct beachfront access' but the sun loungers/umbrellas described are at the pool, not on the shore; the Sissi coast there is rocky and no source describes any organized public beach called Palm Bay. Unresolvable beyond the hotel itself.

name: Παραλία Γαλάνης Νέστου
evidence: This is the river beach at Galani village on the Nestos straits, Xanthi (lat/lng is inland on the river — matches). A dedicated canteen ('Καντίνα Γαλάνη Νέστος', with Facebook page and digital menu) operates at the end of the road at this exact spot, confirming food on site, but no source mentions sunbeds/umbrellas or any beach organization for the river beach itself.

name: Παραλία Σαλαώρας
evidence: Salaora on the Amvrakikos gulf, Arta (unambiguous, matches lat/lng). Topoguide's detailed National-Park page describes a ~1 km shell-gravel shore and birdwatching but mentions no facilities; only the Seatrac sea-access listing exists. No sunbed/umbrella/bar statement either way after multiple query variants.

name: Άη Γιαννάκης
evidence: Ai Giannakis on the Parga–Preveza road, 6 km before Parga (matches lat/lng). Two dedicated pages (taxidologio.gr, travelpreveza.gr) state it is 'οργανωμένη, με ομπρέλες, ξαπλώστρες και θαλάσσια σπορ' with food businesses very close. One round-1 source claimed only a canteen above the beach; the more specific dedicated beach pages win, but the conflict caps confidence at medium.

name: Παντοκράτορας
evidence: Pantokratoras town beach, 2.5 km from Preveza centre (matches lat/lng). Official/local sources (visitpreveza.gr, prevezaguide) state the beach has some umbrellas and showers, free sunbeds for bathers, and a restaurant and cafeteria right by the sea. Minimal but explicit on-beach organization; the food venues are beside the beach, not a beach bar.

name: Παραλία Ριζών
evidence: Rizon/Riza beach below the Lekatsa forest, ~28 km from Preveza (matches lat/lng). The conflict persists at source level: visitpreveza.gr says a few free umbrellas and sunbeds exist, while travelpreveza/discoverpreveza say the beach is not organized with no umbrellas, sunbeds or beach bar (tavernas/camping are in the wider area). Equally specific official-adjacent sources contradicting each other — cannot responsibly claim either way.

name: Παραλία Έλενα
evidence: Resolved the round-1 mystery: this is the private beach of Camping Elena's Beach at Plataria, Thesprotia (campsite address and bay match lat/lng). The campsite has its own beach, a restaurant-cafeteria and mini market, but its official facilities page does not list beach umbrellas or sunbeds, and no independent source describes beach organization. Food exists on-site; sunbeds unverified.

name: Black Rocks Beach
evidence: Black Rocks at the far southern end of Agios Gordios, Corfu (matches lat/lng). Black Rocks Seaside Restaurant Bar sits at the water's edge on this beach and Tripadvisor reviewers state 'the sunbeds are free to use if you buy drinks etc'; the Black Rocks establishment also advertises its own sandy coves with free sunbeds and umbrellas. Patron-model sunbeds + an on-beach restaurant-bar = organized, though guest-priority wording caps confidence at medium.

name: Kanoni Beach
evidence: Name collision resolved by lat/lng (39.794, 19.920): this is Kanoni at Kassiopi, NOT Kanoni of Corfu Town (39.585). Multiple dedicated pages (Greeka, Lovin' Corfu, Sandee, mykerkyra) confirm sunbeds and umbrellas for rent on the rock platforms/hill, a small bar serving the beach, and a taverna next to it.

name: Καλυβιώτης
evidence: Lat/lng points to the Gardenos/Perivoli shore of south Corfu, where 'Taverna Aristos Kalyviotis' operates (the beach is evidently named after it) — consistent with our 'ταβέρνα' amenity. However, no source describes sunbeds, umbrellas or a beach bar at this beach; only the taverna's existence is confirmed.

name: Παραλία Άγιος Νικόλαος
evidence: Lat/lng (39.674, 19.847) lands on Corfu's east coast around Dassia/Kato Korakiana, but no source names an 'Agios Nikolaos' beach there; searches return only the organized Dassia and Ipsos beaches or Agios Nikolaos namesakes on other islands. Cannot pin the record to a documented beach — no facility claim possible.

name: Παραλία Λογγάς
evidence: Loggas/Sunset beach at Peroulades, NW Corfu (matches lat/lng). Majority of dedicated sources (Lovin' Corfu, OnlyInCorfu, projectcorfu) state the narrow beach under the cliffs is unorganized with no sunbeds or umbrellas; the famous 7th Heaven cafe-bar and taverna sit on the cliff top ABOVE the beach, not on it. A minority 'few sunbeds for rent' claim exists, but the specific consensus and the beach's physically vanishing strip favour unorganized.

name: Παραλία Παρακλάδι
evidence: Parakladi near Lefkimmi, SE Corfu (lat/lng in the Lefkimmi coastal strip). Second-round searches in Greek and English return only beach directories with no facility content for Parakladi; the documented organized beaches of the area (Alikes, Molos, Bouka) are distinct. Genuinely unresolvable.

name: Δεύτερη Σπιάντζα
evidence: Defteri ('Second') Spiantza, ~1.1 km south of Gaios, Paxos (matches lat/lng). Sources describe only a small pebbly cove enclosed by low rocky cliffs near town; no facility information found in any guide (thinkingtraveller, cycladia, monolitharo). Likely bare, but no explicit 'unorganized' statement, so staying UNCLEAR.

name: Πόρτο
evidence: Porto, the main port beach of Erikoussa (unambiguous — one settlement on the island, matches lat/lng). Tripadvisor hotel/beach reviews state 'there are sunbeds you can rent daily at the beach' (~€10/day for two) and the hotel section of the beach rents lounge chairs and umbrellas; tavernas (e.g. Leonidas') serve food by the beach. No beach bar as such.
